statement: Management reviews the NIS security policy at least annually and after major incidents or material operational or risk changes; reviews are documented and the policy updated as appropriate.
norm_summary: The NIS security policy must be reviewed by management at least annually and after major incidents or material operational or risk changes; update as appropriate and document the review.
source_excerpt: The network and information system security policy shall be reviewed and, where appropriate, updated by management bodies at least annually and when significant incidents or significant changes to operations or risks occur. The result of the reviews shall be documented.

statement: At least one designated individual must report directly to the management body on network and information system security.
norm_summary: At least one person is required to report directly to the management body about network and information system security.
source_excerpt: At least one person shall report directly to the management bodies on matters of network and information system security.

statement: Document risk assessments, implement a treatment plan, and obtain acceptance of assessments and residual risks from management or properly authorised accountable persons, with management reporting on these matters.
norm_summary: Entities must document risk assessments, implement a treatment plan and obtain acceptance of assessments and residual risks from management or properly authorised accountable persons, with management reporting.
source_excerpt: For the purpose of Article 21(2), point (a) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555, the relevant entities shall establish and maintain an appropriate risk management framework to identify and address the risks posed to the security of network and information systems. The relevant entities shall perform and document risk assessments and, based on the results, establish, implement and monitor a risk treatment plan. Risk assessment results and residual risks shall be accepted by management bodies or, where applicable, by persons who are accountable and have the authority to manage risks, provided that the relevant entities ensure adequate reporting to the management bodies.

statement: Risk assessment results and risk treatment plans are reviewed at planned intervals, at least annually, and promptly after significant incidents or any substantial operational or risk changes.
norm_summary: Risk assessment results and risk treatment plans are reviewed at planned intervals, at least annually, and after significant incidents or changes in operations or risks.
source_excerpt: The relevant entities shall review and, where appropriate, update the risk assessment results and the risk treatment plan at planned intervals and at least annually, and when significant changes to operations or risks or significant incidents occur.

statement: Perform independent information-security reviews by audit-competent persons; internal reviewers must be outside the reporting authority of the personnel and units being assessed.
norm_summary: Independent information-security reviews must be done by audit-competent people; internal reviewers must be outside the reporting authority of personnel in the area being assessed.
source_excerpt: The relevant entities shall develop and maintain processes to conduct independent reviews which shall be carried out by individuals with appropriate audit competence. Where the independent review is conducted by staff members of the relevant entity, the persons conducting the reviews shall not be in the line of authority of the personnel of the area under review. If the size of the relevant entities does not allow such separation of line of authority, the relevant entities shall put in place alternative measures to guarantee the impartiality of the reviews.

statement: An incident-handling policy allocates responsibilities and establishes procedures for detection, analysis, containment or response, recovery, documentation, and timely incident reporting.
norm_summary: An incident-handling policy must allocate responsibilities and establish procedures for detection, analysis, containment or response, recovery, documentation and timely incident reporting.
source_excerpt: For the purpose of Article 21(2), point (b) of Directive (EU) 2022/2555, the relevant entities shall establish and implement an incident handling policy laying down the roles, responsibilities, and procedures for detecting, analysing, containing or responding to, recovering from, documenting and reporting of incidents in a timely manner.

statement: The entity conducts tests of its incident response procedures at planned intervals, with no requirement to perform testing on a fixed daily schedule.
norm_summary: The entity must test its incident response procedures at planned intervals; a fixed daily testing schedule is not prescribed in this point.
source_excerpt: The relevant entities shall test at planned intervals their incident response procedures.

statement: Conduct a post‑incident review, where appropriate after recovery, to identify causes and produce documented lessons for prevention and reduction of future impact.
norm_summary: Post-incident review is called for where appropriate after recovery; where possible it should identify causes and lead to documented lessons for prevention and impact reduction.
source_excerpt: Where appropriate, the relevant entities shall carry out post-incident reviews after recovery from incidents. The post-incident reviews shall identify, where possible, the root cause of the incident and result in documented lessons learned to reduce the occurrence and consequences of future incidents.
